data.name: Slovian Salvation
data.detailed_description:
Your wife and daughter vanished inside an abandoned mine.
But this is no ordinary mine.

Hidden deep below the surface lies a secret laboratory filled with notes, traces of failed experiments, and something far older than science itself. As a desperate husband, you must descend into the darkness, uncover the truth, find your family, and face horrors born from Slavic folklore and human nature.

The deeper you go, the worse it gets:
stronger enemies, more disturbing locations, twisted puzzles, and a chilling line between myth and reality that begins to disappear.

Will you save your family... or be consumed by ancient shadows?

Key Features

  • Survival horror focused on tension and exploration

  • An abandoned mine and hidden laboratory full of secrets

  • Puzzles and survival mechanics

  • Encounters with creatures inspired by Slavic folklore

  • Escalating danger and increasingly difficult challenges

  • A dark 3D world with a moody, immersive visual style

  • A story set in the universe of an original novel

Connected to an original novel

Slovian Salvation is not just a game, but a side story set in the universe of an original novel currently in development.
By playing the game, you step into a parallel path of the story, uncover hidden secrets, and experience a narrative that expands beyond the written page.

data.short_description: A dark 3D survival horror inspired by Slavic folklore. Descend into an abandoned mine and a hidden laboratory, solve puzzles, survive deadly horrors, and uncover the truth behind your wife and daughter’s disappearance.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB or equivalent
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or equivalent
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or equivalent
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Keyboard and mouse required. Recommended resolution: 1920x1080

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fantasy violence, horror themes, blood, disturbing imagery, and dark narrative content. Players may encounter frightening creatures, scenes related to human experimentation, and tense combat/survival situations in oppressive environments. There is no explicit sexual content.
